title: Person: Nasty Roche
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Nasty Roche

anchor.prefix:
and said:

 —There is another way but I won’t tell you what it is.

 Why did he not tell it? His father, who kept the racehorses, must be a magistrate too like Saurin’s father and
anchor.suffix: ’s father. He thought of his own father, of how he sang songs while his mother played and of how he always gave him a shilling when he asked for sixpence and he felt sorry for him
